142970.overview:
X-Men: Legends is an action-RPG with a twist: instead of controlling a sole protagonist, you run around with a whole party of four heroes, where player can control one of them at a time, while the other three are directed by the AI. You can also select different members into your party from a list of 11 mutants from Professor Xavier School for Gifted, including such iconic characters as Cyclops, Wolverine, Storm and so on. Some characters could be unlocked at later stages.

The game story starts with a discovery of new young mutant, Alison, who has a powerful ability - a control over the Earth's magma layer. And human-hating Brotherhood of Mutants is quick to try to capture her to enlist into their numbers. X-Men manage to fight them off only to discover it was also just a part of their plot - to free their leader, an evil mastermind called Magneto from his long-term imprisonment.

The game plays as many traditional ARPGs with an emphasis on direct control and action. Every mutant has four primary battle skills that command their unique abilities plus some that are shared among all of them. It could be anything from Cyclops' optic beam, Gambits' deck of cards or Storms' massive tornado attack.

The N-Gage release shares many similarities to a PC and console game from Raven Software, however the graphic engine and in-game perspective are totally different - instead of fully 3D, almost top-down view, Barking Lizards version has a traditional isometric view with a prerendered world. There are 24 missions in a whole and the game features voice-overs and has some FMV cutscenes from the "bigger" edition. X-Men: Legends could be played either in single player mode or in cooperative multiplayer.

142977.overview:
Rise of Apocalypse is a sequel to X-Men: Legends. This time both X-Men and Brotherhood of Mutants have to work together against a common enemy - Apocalypse, one of the first mutants to walk the Earth and also exceptionally powerful one. He wants not only to crush humanity but his fellow mutants as well and starts with a large scale attack on Genosha, a mutant controlled island nation. 

The N-Gage version is still an isometric four character strong action RPG where all have got a set of unique passive and active abilities, but now there are more characters to choose from, including the past villains from the other side such as Toad or Scarlet Witch and some of the new heroes can fly too. Rise of Apocalypse is slightly less linear with more optional objectives and. Now there's a currency system which means you can also purchase equipment, mostly usable items, like smelling salts or energy packs in the camp, though there are also equipable items such as belts, body armor and gloves.

The game could be played by up to four players online, and as new feature there's a turn based player versus player mode on smaller locations, where more characters could be purchasing with in-game currency. Additional quests could be unlocked through Nokia's online service called Arena.

142988.overview:
The PC-based RPG bestseller, XANADU, has traversed the boundaries of time and is making its newest appearance on the N-Gage game deck as XANADU NEXT!

The village chief's daughter, Momo, has been kidnapped and you have been asked to rescue her. Finding her will not be easy. You will have to battle hordes of demons and monsters, even challenging King-Dragon himself! Can you conquer the darkness hanging over the land and return the light of the gods to XANADU! You are the only one who can save this world. It's time to plunge into the darkness!

472203.overview:
Shoot-em-up as pilot Drake escorting condemned witch Aguira to execution. Asteroid containing Xyanide (thought-materialising substance) strikes vessel, allowing Aguira to create hostile worlds as obstacles.

Originally developed for Xbox with N-Gage and GBA ports planned by Playlogic. Target Q1 2004 but redirected due to poor N-Gage sales. Adapted for Symbian S60 instead, released late 2004 with minimal promotion. Developer Jacco Bikker noted it was 'challenging' with easier settings for S60 phones. Version surfaced online 2011.
